Section 3: Financial Statement Analysis¶

Analyse the financial statements of each company over the last three years. Evaluate

• profitability;
• liquidity;
• efficiency;
• solvency;
• market performance; and
• cash-flow performance.
Use appropriate financial ratios and compare firms within the industry.

3.1 Profitability¶

In [1]:
# Data Processing and library imports
import os
import pandas as pd
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns


# 1. Setup output directory
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# 2. Load raw Excel data
excel_path = "DEMM9X2_GroupResearch_Project.xlsx"
df_raw = pd.read_excel(excel_path, sheet_name="Sheet1")
In [2]:
# Row starting positions per retailer
retailers_pos = {"Shoprite": 4, "Woolworths": 14, "Pick n Pay": 24, "Spar": 34}

# profitability ratios
all_ratios_list = []

# 3. Extract metrics and calculate ratios dynamically (Single Execution)
for name, start_row in retailers_pos.items():
    sub_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 0:4].copy()
    sub_df.columns = ["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"]

    # Clean numeric formatting
    for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]:
        sub_df[yr] = (
            sub_df[yr]
            .astype(str)
            .str.replace(" ", "")
            .str.replace(",", "")
            .astype(float)
        )

    sub_df = sub_df.set_index("Item")

    for yr in ["2023", "2024", "2025"]:
        rev = sub_df.loc["Revenue", yr]
        gp = sub_df.loc["Gross Profit", yr]
        op = sub_df.loc["Operating Profit (EBIT)", yr]
        np_val = sub_df.loc["Net profit", yr]
        eq = sub_df.loc["Total Equity", yr]
        asset = sub_df.loc["Total Assets", yr]

        all_ratios_list.append(
            {
                "Retailer": name,
                "Year": yr,
                "Gross Profit Margin (%)": (gp / rev) * 100,
                "Operating Profit Margin (%)": (op / rev) * 100,
                "Net Profit Margin (%)": (np_val / rev) * 100,
                "Return on Equity (%)": (np_val / eq) * 100,
                "Return on Assets (%)": (np_val / asset) * 100,
            }
        )

# Main ratio DataFrame
df_ratios = pd.DataFrame(all_ratios_list)

# 4. Print formatted tables per retailer and export results to output folder
for name in retailers_pos.keys():
    retailer_df = (
        df_ratios[df_ratios["Retailer"] == name]
        .set_index("Year")
        .drop(columns=["Retailer"])
        .round(2)
        .T[["2025", "2024", "2023"]]
    )

    print(
        f"\n================ {name} Profitability Ratios ================"
    )
    print(retailer_df)

    # Export individual CSV files to output folder
    retailer_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, f"{name}_profitability.csv"))

# Save master ratios table to output folder
df_ratios.round(2).to_csv(
    os.path.join(output_dir, "consolidated_profitability_ratios.csv"),
    index=False,
)

# 1. Create 3x2 grid layout using existing df_ratios
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
axes_flat = axes.flatten()

metrics = [
    ("Gross Profit Margin (%)", axes_flat[0]),
    ("Operating Profit Margin (%)", axes_flat[1]),
    ("Net Profit Margin (%)", axes_flat[2]),
    ("Return on Equity (%)", axes_flat[3]),
    ("Return on Assets (%)", axes_flat[4]),
]

colors = ["#003f5c", "#7a5195", "#ef5675", "#ffa600"]

# 2. Generate bar plots from pre-calculated data
for metric_name, ax in metrics:
    pivoted = df_ratios.pivot(
        index="Year", columns="Retailer", values=metric_name
    )
    pivoted = pivoted[["Shoprite", "Woolworths", "Pick n Pay", "Spar"]]

    pivoted.plot(kind="bar", ax=ax, color=colors, width=0.8)
    ax.set_title(metric_name, fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_ylabel("Percentage (%)")
    ax.set_xlabel("")
    ax.tick_params(axis="x", rotation=0)

    # Cap ROE y-limits for readability across peers
    if metric_name == "Return on Equity (%)":
        ax.set_ylim(-100, 100)
        ax.annotate(
            "PnP 2024 ROE: ~1,126%\n(Distorted by equity drop)",
            xy=(1, 90),
            xytext=(0.5, 60),
            arrowprops=dict(
                facecolor="black", shrink=0.05, headwidth=6, width=1
            ),
            fontsize=8,
            bbox=dict(
                boxstyle="round,pad=0.3", fc="yellow", ec="b", lw=1, alpha=0.5
            ),
        )

    if df_ratios[metric_name].min() < 0:
        ax.axhline(0, color="black", linewidth=0.8, linestyle="--")

# Hide unused 6th panel
axes_flat[5].set_visible(False)

plt.tight_layout()

# 3. Save figure directly into output folder and render
chart_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "profitability_ratios_comparison.png")
plt.savefig(chart_path, dpi=300)
plt.show()

3.2 Liquidity¶

In [4]:
# 1. Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# 2. Extract Liquidity data directly from raw Excel
retailers_pos = {"Shoprite": 4, "Woolworths": 14, "Pick n Pay": 24, "Spar": 34}
all_liquidity_list = []

for name, start_row in retailers_pos.items():
    # Liquidity items are in columns 5:9 (Item, 2025, 2024, 2023)
    sub_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 5:9].copy()
    sub_df.columns = ["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"]

    # Clean space and comma delimiters in numbers
    for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]:
        sub_df[yr] = (
            sub_df[yr]
            .astype(str)
            .str.replace(" ", "")
            .str.replace(",", "")
            .astype(float)
        )

    sub_df = sub_df.set_index("Item")

    for yr in ["2023", "2024", "2025"]:
        ca = sub_df.loc["Total Current Assets", yr]
        inv = sub_df.loc["Inventies (Stock)", yr]
        cash = sub_df.loc["Cash and Cash Equivalence", yr]
        rec = sub_df.loc["Trade and Other Recievables", yr]
        cl = sub_df.loc["Total Curent Liabilities", yr]

        all_liquidity_list.append(
            {
                "Retailer": name,
                "Year": yr,
                "Current Ratio": ca / cl,
                "Quick Ratio (CA - Inv)": (ca - inv) / cl,
                "Quick Ratio (Cash + Rec)": (cash + rec) / cl,
                "Cash Ratio": cash / cl,
            }
        )

df_liquidity = pd.DataFrame(all_liquidity_list)

# 3. Print liquidity tables per retailer and export CSVs
for name in retailers_pos.keys():
    ret_df = (
        df_liquidity[df_liquidity["Retailer"] == name]
        .set_index("Year")
        .drop(columns=["Retailer"])
        .round(2)
        .T[["2025", "2024", "2023"]]
    )

    print(f"\n================ {name} Liquidity Ratios ================")
    print(ret_df)

    ret_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, f"{name}_liquidity.csv"))

df_liquidity.round(2).to_csv(
    os.path.join(output_dir, "consolidated_liquidity_ratios.csv"), index=False
)

3.3 Efficiency¶

In [6]:
# 1. Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

# 2. Extract Efficiency data and compute metrics
retailers_pos = {"Shoprite": 4, "Woolworths": 14, "Pick n Pay": 24, "Spar": 34}
inv_2022 = {"Shoprite": 21879.0, "Woolworths": 16126.0, "Pick n Pay": 8277.3, "Spar": 6760.2}

all_efficiency_list = []

for name, start_row in retailers_pos.items():
    prof_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 0:4].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1).set_index("Item")
    liq_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 5:9].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1).set_index("Item")
    eff_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 10:14].dropna(how="all").set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1).set_index("Item")

    cogs_key = [k for k in eff_df.index if "cost" in str(k).lower() or "sales" in str(k).lower()][0]
    asset_key = [k for k in prof_df.index if "asset" in str(k).lower()][0]

    rev_map = {yr: float(str(prof_df.loc["Revenue", yr]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")) for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]}
    cogs_map = {yr: abs(float(str(eff_df.loc[cogs_key, yr]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", ""))) for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]}
    asset_map = {yr: float(str(prof_df.loc[asset_key, yr]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")) for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]}

    inv_map = {
        "2025": float(str(liq_df.loc["Inventies (Stock)", "2025"]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")),
        "2024": float(str(liq_df.loc["Inventies (Stock)", "2024"]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")),
        "2023": float(str(liq_df.loc["Inventies (Stock)", "2023"]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")),
        "2022": inv_2022[name]
    }

    rec_map = {yr: float(str(liq_df.loc["Trade and Other Recievables", yr]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")) for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]}
    pay_map = {yr: float(str(liq_df.loc["Trade and Other Payables", yr]).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "")) for yr in ["2025", "2024", "2023"]}

    for yr, prev_yr in [("2023", None), ("2024", "2023"), ("2025", "2024")]:
        rev = rev_map[yr]
        cogs = cogs_map[yr]
        tot_assets = asset_map[yr]

        if prev_yr:
            avg_inv = (inv_map[yr] + inv_map[prev_yr]) / 2.0
            avg_rec = (rec_map[yr] + rec_map[prev_yr]) / 2.0
            avg_pay = (pay_map[yr] + pay_map[prev_yr]) / 2.0
        else:
            avg_inv = (inv_map["2023"] + inv_map["2022"]) / 2.0
            avg_rec = rec_map["2023"]
            avg_pay = pay_map["2023"]

        asset_tr = rev / tot_assets
        inv_tr = cogs / avg_inv
        rec_tr = rev / avg_rec
        pay_tr = cogs / avg_pay

        dsi = 365 / inv_tr
        dso = 365 / rec_tr
        dpo = 365 / pay_tr
        ccc = dsi + dso - dpo

        all_efficiency_list.append({
            "Retailer": name,
            "Year": yr,
            "Asset Turnover": asset_tr,
            "Inventory Turnover (Avg)": inv_tr,
            "DSI (Days)": dsi,
            "Receivables Turnover": rec_tr,
            "DSO (Days)": dso,
            "Payables Turnover": pay_tr,
            "DPO (Days)": dpo,
            "CCC (Days)": ccc
        })

df_efficiency = pd.DataFrame(all_efficiency_list)

# 3. Print efficiency tables per retailer and export CSVs
for name in retailers_pos.keys():
    ret_df = (
        df_efficiency[df_efficiency["Retailer"] == name]
        .set_index("Year")
        .drop(columns=["Retailer"])
        .round(2)
        .T[["2025", "2024", "2023"]]
    )

    print(f"\n================ {name} Efficiency Ratios ================")
    print(ret_df)

    ret_df.to_csv(os.path.join(output_dir, f"{name}_efficiency.csv"))

df_efficiency.round(2).to_csv(
    os.path.join(output_dir, "consolidated_efficiency_ratios.csv"), index=False
)

3.4 Solvency¶

In [8]:
# 1. Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

companies = {
    "Shoprite": 4,
    "Woolworths": 14,
    "Pick n Pay": 24,
    "Spar": 34
}

years = ["2025", "2024", "2023"]

def clean_val(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return 0.0
    s = str(val).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "").replace("\xa0", "").strip()
    try:
        return float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0

def get_value_exact_or_specific(df_section, keyword, year_col):
    keyword_clean = keyword.strip().lower()
    for _, row in df_section.iterrows():
        item_name = str(row["Item"]).strip().lower()
        if keyword_clean == "current debt":
            if "non-current" in item_name or "non current" in item_name:
                continue
            if "current debt" in item_name:
                return clean_val(row[year_col])
        else:
            if keyword_clean in item_name:
                return clean_val(row[year_col])
    return 0.0

output_data = []

for comp, start_row in companies.items():
    prof_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 0:4].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1)
    solv_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 5, 15:19].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1)
    
    results = {}
    for yr in years:
        non_curr_debt = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "non-current debt", yr)
        curr_debt = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "current debt", yr)
        lease_liab = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "lease liabilities", yr)
        equity = get_value_exact_or_specific(prof_df, "total equity", yr)
        assets = get_value_exact_or_specific(prof_df, "total assets", yr)
        ebit = get_value_exact_or_specific(prof_df, "operating profit", yr)
        fin_cost = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "finance cost", yr)
        ocf = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "operating activities", yr)
        
        tot_debt_excl_leases = non_curr_debt + curr_debt
        tot_debt_incl_leases = tot_debt_excl_leases + lease_liab
        
        de_excl = tot_debt_excl_leases / equity if equity != 0 else 0.0
        de_incl = tot_debt_incl_leases / equity if equity != 0 else 0.0
        
        fin_da_ratio = tot_debt_incl_leases / assets if assets != 0 else 0.0
        eq_ratio = equity / assets if assets != 0 else 0.0
        tot_liab_da_ratio = 1.0 - eq_ratio  # Total Liabilities / Assets
        
        int_cov = ebit / fin_cost if fin_cost != 0 else 0.0
        cash_cov = ocf / fin_cost if fin_cost != 0 else 0.0
        
        results[yr] = [
            f"{de_excl:.2f}",
            f"{de_incl:.2f}",
            f"{fin_da_ratio:.2f}",
            f"{tot_liab_da_ratio:.2f}",
            f"{eq_ratio:.2f}",
            f"{int_cov:.2f}",
            f"{cash_cov:.2f}"
        ]
    
    metrics = [
        "Debt-to-Equity (excl Leases)",
        "Debt-to-Equity (incl Leases)",
        "Financial Debt-to-Assets Ratio",
        "Total Debt-to-Assets Ratio (Total Liab / Assets)",
        "Equity Ratio",
        "Interest Coverage (EBIT / Fin Cost)",
        "Cash Interest Coverage (OCF / Fin Cost)"
    ]
    
    df_res = pd.DataFrame(results, index=metrics)
    df_res['Company'] = comp
    output_data.append(df_res.reset_index())

final_output_df = pd.concat(output_data, ignore_index=True)
final_output_df = final_output_df[['Company', 'index', '2025', '2024', '2023']]
final_output_df.rename(columns={'index': 'Metric'}, inplace=True)

# Print the ratio outputs to the console
for comp in companies.keys():
    print(f"============== {comp} Solvency & Coverage Ratios ==============")
    comp_df = final_output_df[final_output_df['Company'] == comp].drop(columns=['Company'])
    print(comp_df.to_string(index=False))
    print("\n")

output_filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, "Retailers_Solvency_Coverage_Ratios_Updated.xlsx")
final_output_df.to_excel(output_filepath, index=False)
print(f"Saved successfully to {output_filepath}")

# 1. Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)



companies = {"Shoprite": 4, "Woolworths": 14, "Pick n Pay": 24, "Spar": 34}

years = ["2025", "2024", "2023"]


def clean_val(val):
  if pd.isna(val):
    return 0.0
  s = str(val).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "").replace("\xa0", "").strip()
  try:
    return float(s)
  except ValueError:
    return 0.0


def get_value_exact_or_specific(df_section, keyword, year_col):
  keyword_clean = keyword.strip().lower()
  for _, row in df_section.iterrows():
    item_name = str(row["Item"]).strip().lower()
    if keyword_clean == "current debt":
      if "non-current" in item_name or "non current" in item_name:
        continue
      if "current debt" in item_name:
        return clean_val(row[year_col])
    else:
      if keyword_clean in item_name:
        return clean_val(row[year_col])
  return 0.0


capital_structure_all_years = {}

for yr in years:
  capital_structure_all_years[yr] = {}
  for comp, start_row in companies.items():
    prof_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 0:4].set_axis(
        ["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1
    )
    solv_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 5, 15:19].set_axis(
        ["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1
    )

    equity = get_value_exact_or_specific(prof_df, "total equity", yr)
    assets = get_value_exact_or_specific(prof_df, "total assets", yr)
    non_curr_debt = get_value_exact_or_specific(
        solv_df, "non-current debt", yr
    )
    curr_debt = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "current debt", yr)
    lease_liab = get_value_exact_or_specific(solv_df, "lease liabilities", yr)

    fin_debt = non_curr_debt + curr_debt + lease_liab
    eq_ratio = equity / assets if assets != 0 else 0.0
    tot_liab_ratio = 1.0 - eq_ratio
    fin_debt_ratio = fin_debt / assets if assets != 0 else 0.0
    other_liab_ratio = max(0.0, tot_liab_ratio - fin_debt_ratio)

    capital_structure_all_years[yr][comp] = {
        "Equity Ratio": eq_ratio,
        "Financial Debt Ratio": fin_debt_ratio,
        "Other Liabilities Ratio": other_liab_ratio,
    }

# Plot pie charts for all three years (3 rows for years, 4 columns for companies)
fig, axes = plt.subplots(3, 4, figsize=(16, 12))

colors = ["#2ca02c", "#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e"]

for row_idx, yr in enumerate(years):
  for col_idx, (comp, ratios) in enumerate(
      capital_structure_all_years[yr].items()
  ):
    ax = axes[row_idx, col_idx]

    # Collect raw sizes and guard against negatives / zero sums
    raw_sizes = [
        ratios["Equity Ratio"],
        ratios["Financial Debt Ratio"],
        ratios["Other Liabilities Ratio"],
    ]
    cleaned_sizes = [max(0.0, float(v)) for v in raw_sizes]
    total_size = sum(cleaned_sizes)

    if total_size <= 0:
      sizes = [1.0, 0.0, 0.0]
    else:
      sizes = [v / total_size for v in cleaned_sizes]

    labels = [
        f'Equity ({ratios["Equity Ratio"]:.1%})',
        f'Financial Debt ({ratios["Financial Debt Ratio"]:.1%})',
        f'Other Liab. ({ratios["Other Liabilities Ratio"]:.1%})',
    ]

    ax.pie(
        sizes,
        labels=labels,
        startangle=140,
        colors=colors,
        wedgeprops=dict(width=0.4, edgecolor="w"),
    )
    ax.set_title(f"{comp} ({yr})", fontsize=11, fontweight="bold")

plt.tight_layout()

# Save visual to output directory
pie_filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, "Capital_Structure_Donut_All_Years.png")
plt.savefig(pie_filepath, dpi=300)
plt.show()

print(f"Multi-year pie charts saved successfully to {pie_filepath}")

# 1. Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)


companies = {
    "Shoprite": 4,
    "Woolworths": 14,
    "Pick n Pay": 24,
    "Spar": 34
}

years = ["2025", "2024", "2023"]

def clean_val(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return 0.0
    s = str(val).replace(" ", "").replace(",", "").replace("\xa0", "").strip()
    try:
        return float(s)
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0

def get_val(df, kw, yr):
    """Uses exact match for solvency lines to prevent substring overlap, 
    and flexible containment for other sections."""
    for _, row in df.iterrows():
        item_str = str(row["Item"]).strip().lower()
        # Exact match check for solvency items to avoid 'current debt' matching 'non-current debt'
        if item_str == kw.lower() or (kw.lower() in ["non-current debt", "current debt"] and item_str == kw.lower()):
            return clean_val(row[yr])
        elif kw.lower() not in ["non-current debt", "current debt"] and kw.lower() in item_str:
            return clean_val(row[yr])
    return 0.0

all_records = []

for comp, start_row in companies.items():
    prof_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 0:4].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1)
    liq_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 6, 5:9].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1)
    solv_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 5, 15:19].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1)
    mkt_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 4, 20:24].set_axis(["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1)

    mcap, ev, pe, dy, dc, pb, ev_ebitda = [], [], [], [], [], [], []

    for yr in years:
        price = get_val(mkt_df, "Closing Share Price", yr)
        shares = get_val(mkt_df, "Share in Issue", yr)
        heps_cents = get_val(mkt_df, "DHEPS", yr)
        dps_cents = get_val(mkt_df, "DPS", yr)
        
        equity = get_val(prof_df, "Total Equity", yr)
        ebitda = get_val(prof_df, "Operating Profit", yr)
        
        # Exact matching enforced for debt isolation
        non_curr_debt = get_val(solv_df, "Non-Current Debt", yr)
        curr_debt = get_val(solv_df, "Current Debt", yr)
        lease_liab = get_val(solv_df, "Lease Liabilities", yr)
        cash = get_val(liq_df, "Cash and Cash Equivalence", yr)
        
        market_cap = price * shares / 1e6  # Converted to millions (Rm)
        total_debt = non_curr_debt + curr_debt  # Correctly isolated non-current + current debt
        enterprise_val = market_cap + total_debt + lease_liab - cash
        
        heps = heps_cents / 100.0
        dps = dps_cents / 100.0
        
        mcap.append(market_cap)
        ev.append(enterprise_val)
        pe.append(price / heps if heps != 0 and not np.isnan(heps) else np.nan)
        dy.append((dps / price) * 100 if price != 0 else np.nan)
        dc.append(heps / dps if dps != 0 and dps > 0 else np.nan)
        pb.append(market_cap / equity if equity != 0 else np.nan)
        ev_ebitda.append(enterprise_val / ebitda if ebitda != 0 else np.nan)

        all_records.append({
            "Company": comp,
            "Year": yr,
            "Market Cap (Rm)": market_cap,
            "Enterprise Value (Rm)": enterprise_val,
            "P/E Ratio": pe[-1],
            "Dividend Yield (%)": dy[-1],
            "Dividend Cover": dc[-1],
            "P/B Ratio": pb[-1],
            "EV/EBITDA": ev_ebitda[-1]
        })

    res_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Metric": ["Market Cap (Rm)", "Enterprise Value (Rm)", "P/E Ratio", "Dividend Yield (%)", "Dividend Cover", "P/B Ratio", "EV/EBITDA"],
        "2025": [mcap[0], ev[0], pe[0], dy[0], dc[0], pb[0], ev_ebitda[0]],
        "2024": [mcap[1], ev[1], pe[1], dy[1], dc[1], pb[1], ev_ebitda[1]],
        "2023": [mcap[2], ev[2], pe[2], dy[2], dc[2], pb[2], ev_ebitda[2]]
    }).set_index("Metric")
    
    print(f"============================== {comp} Market Performance Ratios ==============================")
    print(res_df.to_string(formatters={
        "2025": lambda x: f"{x:10.2f}" if not pd.isna(x) else f"{'nan':>10}",
        "2024": lambda x: f"{x:10.2f}" if not pd.isna(x) else f"{'nan':>10}",
        "2023": lambda x: f"{x:10.2f}" if not pd.isna(x) else f"{'nan':>10}"
    }))
    print("\n")

# Save complete summary to CSV
df_all = pd.DataFrame(all_records)
csv_filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, "All_Market_Valuation_Ratios.csv")
df_all.to_csv(csv_filepath, index=False)

  )
  cf_df = df_raw.iloc[start_row : start_row + 5, 25:29].set_axis(
      ["Item", "2025", "2024", "2023"], axis=1
  )

  cf_margin_vals, cros_vals, ocf_ratio_vals, cf_quality_vals = [], [], [], []

  for yr in years:
    rev = get_val(prof_df, "Revenue", yr)
    ebit = get_val(prof_df, "Operating Profit", yr)
    curr_liab = get_val(liq_df, "Total Curent Liabilities", yr) or get_val(
        liq_df, "Total Current Liabilities", yr
    )

    cgo = get_val(cf_df, "Cash generated from operations", yr)
    ocf = get_val(
        solv_df, "Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities", yr
    ) or get_val(cf_df, "Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities", yr)

    cf_margin = (ocf / rev) * 100 if rev != 0 else np.nan
    cros = (cgo / rev) * 100 if rev != 0 else np.nan
    ocf_ratio = (ocf / curr_liab) if curr_liab != 0 else np.nan
    cf_quality = (ocf / ebit) if ebit != 0 else np.nan

    cf_margin_vals.append(cf_margin)
    cros_vals.append(cros)
    ocf_ratio_vals.append(ocf_ratio)
    cf_quality_vals.append(cf_quality)

    all_records.append({
        "Company": comp,
        "Year": yr,
        "Cash Flow Margin (%)": cf_margin,
        "CROS (%)": cros,
        "OCF Ratio": ocf_ratio,
        "Cash Flow Quality Ratio": cf_quality,
    })

  res_df = pd.DataFrame({
      "Metric": [
          "Cash Flow Margin (%)",
          "CROS (%)",
          "OCF Ratio",
          "Cash Flow Quality Ratio",
      ],
      "2025": [
          cf_margin_vals[0],
          cros_vals[0],
          ocf_ratio_vals[0],
          cf_quality_vals[0],
      ],
      "2024": [
          cf_margin_vals[1],
          cros_vals[1],
          ocf_ratio_vals[1],
          cf_quality_vals[1],
      ],
      "2023": [
          cf_margin_vals[2],
          cros_vals[2],
          ocf_ratio_vals[2],
          cf_quality_vals[2],
      ],
  }).set_index("Metric")

  print(
      f"============================== {comp} Cash Flow Performance Ratios"
      " =============================="
  )
  print(
      res_df.to_string(formatters={
          "2025": lambda x: f"{x:10.2f}" if not pd.isna(x) else f"{'nan':>10}",
          "2024": lambda x: f"{x:10.2f}" if not pd.isna(x) else f"{'nan':>10}",
          "2023": lambda x: f"{x:10.2f}" if not pd.isna(x) else f"{'nan':>10}",
      })
  )
  print("\n")

# Save complete summary to CSV
df_all = pd.DataFrame(all_records)
csv_filepath = os.path.join(output_dir, "All_Cash_Flow_Ratios.csv")
df_all.to_csv(csv_filepath, index=False)

#  Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)


# Define retailers and their starting row positions in the sheet
companies = [
    {"name": "Shoprite", "start_row": 2},
    {"name": "Woolworths", "start_row": 12},
    {"name": "Pick n Pay", "start_row": 22},
    {"name": "Spar", "start_row": 32}
]

results = []

for comp in companies:
    r = comp["start_row"]
    comp_name = comp["name"]
    
    # Extract items from columns 15 to 18
    solvency_items = {}
    max_sub = min(r + 11, df.shape[0])
    for sub_r in range(r + 3, max_sub):
        item_name = df.iloc[sub_r, 15]
        if pd.notna(item_name):
            val_2025 = df.iloc[sub_r, 16]
            val_2024 = df.iloc[sub_r, 17]
            val_2023 = df.iloc[sub_r, 18]
            solvency_items[str(item_name).strip()] = {2025: val_2025, 2024: val_2024, 2023: val_2023}
            
    # Identify Operating Cash Flow row key dynamically
    ocf_key = "Net Cash Flow from Operating Activities (OCF)"
    if ocf_key not in solvency_items:
        for k in solvency_items:
            if 'Operating' in k or 'OCF' in k:
                ocf_key = k
                break
                
    non_curr_debt = solvency_items.get("Non-Current Debt", {2025: 0, 2024: 0, 2023: 0})
    curr_debt = solvency_items.get("Current Debt", {2025: 0, 2024: 0, 2023: 0})
    ocf_vals = solvency_items.get(ocf_key, {2025: 0, 2024: 0, 2023: 0})
    
    # Iterate across years (columns corresponding to 2025, 2024, 2023)
    for idx, year in enumerate([2025, 2024, 2023]):
        col_idx = idx + 1
        yr_val = df.iloc[r + 2, col_idx]
        if pd.isna(yr_val):
            continue
        
        n_debt = float(non_curr_debt.get(yr_val, 0) or 0)
        c_debt = float(curr_debt.get(yr_val, 0) or 0)
        ocf = float(ocf_vals.get(yr_val, 0) or 0)
        
        # Total Debt = Non-Current Debt + Current Debt (Excluding Leases)
        total_debt = n_debt + c_debt
        
        # Cash Flow-to-Debt Ratio = OCF / Total Debt
        ratio = ocf / total_debt if total_debt != 0 else None
        
        results.append({
            "Company": comp_name,
            "Year": int(yr_val),
            "Operating Cash Flow (OCF)": ocf,
            "Total Debt": total_debt,
            "Cash Flow-to-Debt Ratio": ratio
        })

# Create DataFrame and save to CSV inside the output folder
df_results = pd.DataFrame(results)
output_file_path = os.path.join(output_dir, "cash_flow_to_debt_strict_results.csv")
df_results.to_csv(output_file_path, index=False)

# 1. Output setup
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

TAX_RATE = 0.27

company_blocks = {
    "Shoprite": 1,
    "Woolworths": 11,
    "Pick n Pay": 21,
    "Spar": 31
}

def clean_val(val):
    if pd.isna(val):
        return 0.0
    if isinstance(val, (int, float)):
        return float(val)
    val_str = str(val).replace("\xa0", "").replace(" ", "").strip()
    try:
        return float(val_str)
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0

# 2. COMPUTE AND PRINT TABULAR MATRICES
for company, start_row in company_blocks.items():
    solvency_block = df_raw.iloc[start_row+3 : start_row+9, [15, 16, 17, 18]].copy()
    solvency_block.columns = ['Item', '2025', '2024', '2023']
    fin_row = solvency_block[solvency_block['Item'].str.strip() == 'Finance Cost']
    
    years = ['2025', '2024', '2023']
    tax_shields, after_tax_costs = [], []
    
    for yr in years:
        fin_c = clean_val(fin_row[yr].values[0]) if not fin_row.empty else 0.0
        ts = round(TAX_RATE * fin_c, 2)
        atc = round(fin_c - ts, 2)
        
        tax_shields.append(f"{ts:.2f}")
        after_tax_costs.append(f"{atc:.2f}")
        
    res_df = pd.DataFrame({
        '2025': [tax_shields[0], after_tax_costs[0]],
        '2024': [tax_shields[1], after_tax_costs[1]],
        '2023': [tax_shields[2], after_tax_costs[2]]
    }, index=['Tax Shield (Rm)', 'After-Tax Finance Cost (Rm)'])
    
    res_df.index.name = "Metric"
    
    print(f"============================ {company} Tax Advantage of Debt ============================")
    print(res_df.to_string())
    print("\n")

# Create output directory
output_dir = "output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)


companies = {"Shoprite": 1, "Woolworths": 11, "Pick n Pay": 21, "Spar": 31}

all_records = []
for comp, start in companies.items():
  for yr_idx, yr in enumerate([2023, 2024, 2025]):
    col_idx = 3 - yr_idx
    sol_col = 18 - yr_idx

    ebit = float(
        str(df_raw.iloc[start + 5, col_idx]).replace(" ", "").replace("\xa0", "")
    )
    total_assets = float(
        str(df_raw.iloc[start + 8, col_idx]).replace(" ", "").replace("\xa0", "")
    )

    non_curr = float(
        str(df_raw.iloc[start + 3, sol_col]).replace(" ", "").replace("\xa0", "")
    )
    curr = float(
        str(df_raw.iloc[start + 4, sol_col]).replace(" ", "").replace("\xa0", "")
    )
    lease = float(
        str(df_raw.iloc[start + 5, sol_col]).replace(" ", "").replace("\xa0", "")
    )
    fin_cost = float(
        str(df_raw.iloc[start + 6, sol_col]).replace(" ", "").replace("\xa0", "")
    )

    total_debt = non_curr + curr + lease
    leverage_pct = (total_debt / total_assets) * 100
    icr = ebit / fin_cost if fin_cost > 0 else 0.0

    all_records.append({
        "Company": comp,
        "Year": yr,
        "Leverage": leverage_pct,
        "ICR": icr,
    })

panel_df = pd.DataFrame(all_records)

)
plt.axhline(
    3.0, color="green", linestyle=":", alpha=0.8, label="ICR = 3.0x (Safe / Strong)"
)

# 5. Add User-Defined Actual Leverage Threshold Lines (Vertical)
plt.axvline(
    30.0, color="purple", linestyle=":", alpha=0.8, label="AL < 30% (Own Funds / Safe)"
)
plt.axvline(
    50.0, color="brown", linestyle=":", alpha=0.8, label="30% < AL < 50% (Balance risk and growth)"
)

# 6. Formatting and Labels
plt.title(
    "Trade-off Dynamics with Risk Classification Boundaries (2023–2025)",
    fontsize=12,
    fontweight="bold",
    pad=15,
)
plt.xlabel("Actual Leverage Ratio (Total Debt / Total Assets %)", fontsize=10)
plt.ylabel("Interest Coverage Ratio (EBIT / Finance Cost)", fontsize=10)
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.xlim(28, 70)
plt.ylim(-0.2, 5.0)

# 7. Clean Legend Placement
plt.legend(loc="upper left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), frameon=True, fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()

# 8. Save and Show Output
plt.savefig("output/tradeoff_trajectory_zones_clean.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()

7.9 Signalling theory: Covered¶
